summary: Check plugin docs render with ansible-doc -t, then install sanity requirements and run ansible-test sanity --test validate-modules, optionally with --docker, to confirm docs match the argument_spec.
questions: How do I check my module documentation matches its argument_spec?
How do I preview my plugin docs locally?

answer_card.title: Testing plugin documentation
answer_card.answer_md:
Quick check: `ansible-doc -t <plugin_type> <name>` (add `-M /path` if needed).

Before submitting:
```bash
pip install --user -r test/lib/ansible_test/_data/requirements/sanity.txt
ansible-test sanity --test validate-modules mymodule
# or with all requirements preinstalled:
ansible-test sanity --docker --test validate-modules mymodule
```
